issues.spec_citation: C++ error-handling hygiene for DuckDB public UDF inputs
issues.evidence: CQL native numeric parse helpers used catch-all handlers in ParseUncertainRange and cql_precision.
issues.root_cause: Parse fallback logic treated every thrown condition as ordinary invalid input.
issues.resolution: Replaced catch-all handlers with catch (const std::exception&) in the affected CQL native parse paths.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath type assertions over FHIR choice elements; DuckDB native-vs-fallback public UDF parity
issues.evidence: The vectorized Python fhirpath() public surface did not share the choice-field assertion fallback already used by scalar wrappers.
issues.root_cause: Choice assertion handling was implemented in scalar wrapper helpers but not in the vectorized fhirpath_udf path.
issues.resolution: Applied choice assertion/ofType fallback handling to fhirpath_udf() and added native/fallback parity tests.
issues.verified_in: Focused parity pytest 20 passed; full conformance 2822/2822; full pytest 7150 passed, 5 skipped

issues.spec_citation: CQL Quantity values must be finite representable numeric quantities at the SQL UDF boundary
issues.evidence: Python fallback ToQuantity could accept an extremely large finite decimal string and overflow during float materialization.
issues.root_cause: Quantity formatting checked Decimal parseability but not finite DOUBLE representability before JSON serialization.
issues.resolution: Added finite Decimal and finite float guards in the Python CQL quantity UDF path.
issues.verified_in: Focused parity pytest 20 passed; full conformance 2822/2822; full pytest 7150 passed, 5 skipped

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath expression validation must reject unknown functions while preserving valid known public functions
issues.evidence: fhirpath_is_valid('foo()') could return true from the native parse-only AST path.
issues.root_cause: Native expression validation did not reject parsed function-call AST nodes whose function names were unknown.
issues.resolution: Added native AST known-function validation and aligned Python fallback NotImplemented handling for true unknown functions.
